## Backing Query SQL

```sql
SELECT
  _stage_inner."orders.order_date" AS "order_date",
  _stage_inner."orders.rev" AS "rev"
FROM (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date) AS "orders.order_date",
    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.rev"
  FROM orders AS orders
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date)
) AS _stage_inner
```

args.message: This can't be answered from monthly_rev. That summary adds up order amounts for each whole month, so it has one row per month (January 2025 is a single value) and no daily detail. When I asked it for a daily breakdown, the query failed because a monthly figure can't be split into days. Daily revenue for January 2025 would have to come from the underlying orders data (sum of amount by day of order_date), not from this summary.
